Mutant Feature - Lizard Head.name: Mutant Feature - Lizard Head
Mutant Feature - Lizard Head.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Lizard Head
A scaled lizard head with a long snout and a ridge of spines on a human body.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Lizard Head.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual only: a permanent Mutant body feature; keep it in every portrait, even with an Emitter or Transformation Quirk Type. Adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two features for one body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the alphabetically first. Quirkless or No Quirk: no heteromorph body; do not draw it.

Portrait: a lizard's head on a human neck and body: long tapered snout, wide lipless mouth, nostrils at the tip, side-set eyes under heavy brow ridges, small ear openings, no external ears. Fine scales, larger on the crown, follow the selected skin color; a low spine ridge runs from the crown down the back of the neck. Selected hair grows from the back of the skull behind the ridge; facial hair traits are skipped. If another Mutant Feature adds ears, a beak or tusks, this head's anatomy takes precedence.
